From Fsub.ExtendedBase Require Import Fsub_LetSum_Definitions.

Theorem preservation : forall E e e' T,
  typing E e T ->
  red e e' ->
  typing E e' T.

Theorem progress : forall e T,
  typing empty e T ->
  value e \/ exists e', red e e'.

1	(* Based on the System F-sub development by Brian Aydemir and Arthur
2	   Charguéraud, with Aaron Bohannon, Jeffrey Vaughan, and Dimitrios Vytiniotis. *)

14	Parameter B : Set.
15	
16	Context `{O : Order B}.
17	
18	Context `{L : Lattice B}.
19	
20	Context `{@LOSet B O L}.
21	
22	Inductive qua : Set :=
23	  | qua_base : B -> qua
24	  | qua_bvar : nat -> qua
25	  | qua_fvar : atom -> qua
26	  | qua_meet : qua -> qua -> qua
27	  | qua_join : qua -> qua -> qua
28	.
29

31	  | typ_top : typ
32	  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
33	  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
34	  | typ_arrow : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
35	  | typ_all : typ -> qtyp -> typ
36	  | typ_qall : qua -> qtyp -> typ
37	  | typ_sum : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
38	  | typ_pair : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
39	  | typ_ref : qtyp -> typ
40	with qtyp : Set :=
41	  | qtyp_qtyp : qua -> typ -> qtyp
42	.
43	
44	Inductive exp : Set :=
45	  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
46	  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
47	  | exp_abs : qua -> qtyp -> exp -> exp
48	  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
49	  | exp_tabs : qua -> typ -> exp -> exp
50	  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
51	  | exp_qabs : qua -> qua -> exp -> exp
52	  | exp_qapp : exp -> qua -> exp
53	  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
54	  | exp_inl : qua -> exp -> exp
55	  | exp_inr : qua -> exp -> exp
56	  | exp_case : exp -> exp -> exp -> exp
57	  | exp_pair : qua -> exp -> exp -> exp
58	  | exp_first : exp -> exp
59	  | exp_second : exp -> exp

80	Definition concrete_qua : Set := B.
81	
82	Fixpoint concretize (q : qua) : (option concrete_qua) :=
83	  match q with
84	  | qua_base b => Some b
85	  | qua_fvar X => None
86	  | qua_bvar n => None
87	  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>
88	    match (concretize Q1, concretize Q2) with
89	    | (Some b1, Some b2) => Some (b1 ⊔ b2)
90	    | _ => None
91	    end
92	  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 =>
93	    match (concretize Q1, concretize Q2) with
94	    | (Some b1, Some b2) => Some (b1 ⊓ b2)
95	    | _ => None
96	    end
97	  end.
98	
99	Definition abstractize (s : concrete_qua) :=
100	  qua_base s.
101	
102	Fixpoint open_qq_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (Q : qua)  {struct Q} : qua :=
103	  match Q with
104	  | qua_base b => qua_base b
105	  | qua_bvar J => if (K == J) then R else (qua_bvar J)
106	  | qua_fvar X => qua_fvar X
107	  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
108	  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => qua_join (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
109	  end.
110	
111	Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
112	  match T with
113	  | typ_top => typ_top
114	  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
115	  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
116	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
117	  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
118	  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T)
119	  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
120	  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
121	  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_tqt_rec K U T1)
122	  end
123	with open_tqt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
124	  match T with
125	  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (open_tt_rec K U T)
126	  end.
127	
128	Fixpoint open_qt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
129	  match T with
130	  | typ_top => typ_top
131	  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
132	  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
133	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
134	  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_qt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
135	  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T)
136	  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
137	  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
138	  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_qqt_rec K R T1)
139	  end
140	with open_qqt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
141	  match T with
142	  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qt_rec K R T)
143	  end.
144	
145	Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
146	  match e with
147	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
148	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
149	  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (open_tqt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
150	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
151	  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
152	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
153	  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
154	  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_te_rec K U e1) Q
155	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2)
156	  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_te_rec K U e1)
157	  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_te_rec K U e2)
158	  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
159	      exp_case (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2) (open_te_rec (S K) U e3)
160	  | exp_pair R e1 e2 => exp_pair R (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
161	  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_te_rec K U e1)
162	  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_te_rec K U e2)
163	  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_te_rec K U e1)
164	  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
165	  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_te_rec K U e1)
166	  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
167	  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_te_rec K U e1)
168	  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_te_rec K U e1)
169	  end.
170	
171	Fixpoint open_qe_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
172	  match e with
173	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
174	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
175	  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qqt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
176	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
177	  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)

817	      concretize P = Some cP ->

(* Based on the System F-sub development by Brian Aydemir and Arthur
   Charguéraud, with Aaron Bohannon, Jeffrey Vaughan, and Dimitrios Vytiniotis. *)

Require Export Fsub.ExtendedBase.LabelMap.

Require Export Fsub.ExtendedBase.Label.

Require Export Fsub.FqMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Require Export Fsub.ExtendedBase.Lattice.

Parameter B : Set.

Context `{O : Order B}.

Context `{L : Lattice B}.

Context `{@LOSet B O L}.

Inductive qua : Set :=
  | qua_base : B -> qua
  | qua_bvar : nat -> qua
  | qua_fvar : atom -> qua
  | qua_meet : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_join : qua -> qua -> qua
.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_qall : qua -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_sum : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_pair : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_ref : qtyp -> typ
with qtyp : Set :=
  | qtyp_qtyp : qua -> typ -> qtyp
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : qua -> qtyp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : qua -> typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_qabs : qua -> qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_qapp : exp -> qua -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inl : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inr : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_case : exp -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_pair : qua -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_first : exp -> exp
  | exp_second : exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref_label : qua -> label -> exp
  | exp_deref : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_ref : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_upqual : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_check : qua -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Coercion qua_bvar : nat >-> qua.

Coercion qua_fvar : atom >-> qua.

Definition concrete_qua : Set := B.

Fixpoint concretize (q : qua) : (option concrete_qua) :=
  match q with
  | qua_base b => Some b
  | qua_fvar X => None
  | qua_bvar n => None
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1, concretize Q2) with
    | (Some b1, Some b2) => Some (b1 ⊔ b2)
    | _ => None
    end
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1, concretize Q2) with
    | (Some b1, Some b2) => Some (b1 ⊓ b2)
    | _ => None
    end
  end.

Definition abstractize (s : concrete_qua) :=
  qua_base s.

Fixpoint open_qq_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (Q : qua)  {struct Q} : qua :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base b => qua_base b
  | qua_bvar J => if (K == J) then R else (qua_bvar J)
  | qua_fvar X => qua_fvar X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => qua_join (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  end.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_tqt_rec K U T1)
  end
with open_tqt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (open_tt_rec K U T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_qt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_qt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_qqt_rec K R T1)
  end
with open_qqt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qt_rec K R T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (open_tqt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_te_rec K U e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2) (open_te_rec (S K) U e3)
  | exp_pair R e1 e2 => exp_pair R (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_qe_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qqt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qt_rec K R V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qq_rec K R Q)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qq_rec K R Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label (open_qq_rec K R P) l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_ee_rec k f e1)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Definition open_qq Q R := open_qq_rec 0 R Q.

Definition open_qe e R := open_qe_rec 0 R e.

Definition open_qt T R := open_qt_rec 0 R T.

Definition open_qqt T R := open_qqt_rec 0 R T.

Definition open_tqt T R := open_tqt_rec 0 R T.

Inductive qual : qua -> Prop :=
  | qual_base : forall b,
      qual (qua_base b)
  | qual_fvar : forall (X : atom),
      qual (qua_fvar X)
  | qual_meet : forall Q1 Q2,
      qual Q1 ->
      qual Q2 ->
      qual (qua_meet Q1 Q2)
  | qual_join : forall Q1 Q2,
      qual Q1 ->
      qual Q2 ->
      qual (qua_join Q1 Q2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> qtype (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_qall : forall L Q T,
      qual Q ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> qtype (open_qqt T X)) ->
      type (typ_qall Q T)
  | type_sum : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | type_pair : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_pair T1 T2)
with qtype : qtyp -> Prop :=
  | qtype_qtyp : forall Q T,
      qual Q ->
      type T ->
      qtype (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L P T e1,
      qual P ->
      qtype T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs P T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L P T e1,
      qual P ->
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs P T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_qabs : forall L P Q e1,
      qual P ->
      qual Q ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_qe e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_qabs P Q e1)
  | expr_qapp : forall e1 Q,
      expr e1 ->
      qual Q ->
      expr (exp_qapp e1 Q)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_inl : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_inl P e1)
  | expr_inr : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_inr P e1)
  | expr_case : forall L e1 e2 e3,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e3 x)) ->
      expr (exp_case e1 e2 e3)
  | expr_pair : forall P e1 e2,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_pair P e1 e2)
  | expr_first : forall e1,
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_first e1)
  | expr_second : forall e1,
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_second e1)
  | expr_upqual : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_upqual P e1)
  | expr_check : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_check P e1)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : qtyp -> binding
  | bind_qua : qua -> binding.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive wf_qua : env -> qua -> Prop :=
  | wf_qua_base : forall E b,
      wf_qua E (qua_base b)
  | wf_qua_fvar : forall R E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_qua R) E ->
      wf_qua E (qua_fvar X)
  | wf_qua_meet : forall E Q1 Q2,
      wf_qua E Q1 ->
      wf_qua E Q2 ->
      wf_qua E (qua_meet Q1 Q2)
  | wf_qua_join : forall E Q1 Q2,
      wf_qua E Q1 ->
      wf_qua E Q2 ->
      wf_qua E (qua_join Q1 Q2)
.

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_qall : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_qua E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E) (open_qqt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_qall T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_sum : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_pair : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_pair T1 T2)
with wf_qtyp : env -> qtyp -> Prop :=
  | wf_qtyp_qtyp : forall E Q T,
      wf_qua E Q ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_qtyp E (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : qtyp),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qtyp E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E)
  | wf_env_qua : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (Q : qua),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E)
.

Inductive subqual : env -> qua -> qua -> Prop :=
  | subqual_top : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E Q (qua_base top)
  | subqual_bot : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E (qua_base bot) Q
  | subqual_eval_elim : forall E Q' Q R b,
      subqual E Q Q' ->
      concretize Q' = Some b ->
      subqual E (qua_base b) R ->
      subqual E Q R
  | subqual_eval_intro : forall E Q' Q R b,
      subqual E Q' R ->
      concretize Q' = Some b ->
      subqual E Q (qua_base b) ->
      subqual E Q R
  | subqual_lift_elem : forall E b1 b2,
      wf_env E ->
      ord b1 b2 ->
      subqual E (qua_base b1) (qua_base b2)
  | subqual_refl_qvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E (qua_fvar X) ->
      subqual E (qua_fvar X) (qua_fvar X)
  | subqual_trans_qvar : forall R E Q X,
      binds X (bind_qua R) E ->
      subqual E R Q ->
      subqual E (qua_fvar X) Q
  | subqual_join_inl : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E Q R1 ->
      wf_qua E R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_join R1 R2)
  | subqual_join_inr : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      wf_qua E R1 ->
      subqual E Q R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_join R1 R2)
  | subqual_join_elim : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E R1 Q ->
      subqual E R2 Q ->
      subqual E (qua_join R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_eliml : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E R1 Q ->
      wf_qua E R2 ->
      subqual E (qua_meet R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_elimr : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      wf_qua E R1 ->
      subqual E R2 Q ->
      subqual E (qua_meet R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_intro : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E Q R1 ->
      subqual E Q R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_meet R1 R2)
.

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqtype E T1 S1 ->
      subqtype E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->

  | typing_app : forall Q T1 E e1 e2 T2,

  | typing_tabs : forall L P E V e1 T1,
      wf_qua E P ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tqt T1 X)) ->

  | typing_tapp : forall Q T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_all T1 T2)) ->

  | typing_qabs : forall L E P Q e1 T1,

So the general pattern: substitution lemmas require the substituted thing to be well-formed (expr/type/qual), and typed. Good.

Now the "no-shift" opening/substitution: We must prove commutation lemmas like `subst_ee x v (open_ee e y) = open_ee (subst_ee x v e) y`. Is this true given v expr? The LHS: open e y then subst x v. subst_ee replaces fvar x. open_ee already replaced bvar 0 (relative) at the top with fvar y. Then subst descends into the whole term including inserted y (fvar y unaffected if y≠x) but does NOT descend into v (v only inserted after subst, wait order: open first, then subst: the inserted y is just fvar y; no v there). Inside e's other parts, subst descends and may insert v unter binders, but v has no free bvars, so no capture. RHS: subst into e (inserting v possibly) then open with y: open replaces bvar k with y. Could it replace bvars inside inserted v? v has no free bvars, so no. And inside e, subst and open commute on bvar indices (subst doesn't change indices, open doesn't depend on fvars). So true. Need v "expr" for no free bvars. Hmm, in preservation case red_abs, v2 is value so expr. In typing substitution lemma generally, v is typed hence expr, fine.

Similarly for types: `open_tt`/`open_qt` etc. with substitutions of well-formed types/quas. And mutual commutations.

```
From Fsub.ExtendedBase Require Import Fsub_LetSum_Definitions.
From Fsub.FqMeta Require Import Metatheory.
```

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Free variables                                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint fv_qua (Q : qua) : atoms :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base _ => empty
  | qua_bvar _ => empty
  | qua_fvar X => singleton X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qua Q1) (fv_qua Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qua Q1) (fv_qua Q2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => empty
  | typ_bvar _ => empty
  | typ_fvar X => singleton X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => union (fv_qtyp T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => union (fv_typ T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => union (fv_qua Q) (fv_qtyp T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => union (fv_qtyp T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => union (fv_qtyp T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_ref T => fv_qtyp T
  end
with fv_qtyp (T : qtyp) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => union (fv_qua Q) (fv_typ T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_exp (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => empty
  | exp_fvar x => singleton x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_qtyp V) (fv_exp e1))
  | exp_app e1 e2 => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_typ V) (fv_exp e1))
  | exp_tapp e1 V => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_typ V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_qua Q) (fv_exp e1))
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_qua Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => union (fv_exp e1) (union (fv_exp e2) (fv_exp e3))
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2))
  | exp_first e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_second e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_ref P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_ref_label P _ => fv_qua P
  | exp_deref e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitutions                                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint subst_qq (X : atom) (R Q : qua) {struct Q} : qua :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base b => qua_base b
  | qua_bvar n => qua_bvar n
  | qua_fvar Y => if X == Y then R else qua_fvar Y
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (subst_qq X R Q1) (subst_qq X R Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => qua_join (subst_qq X R Q1) (subst_qq X R Q2)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_tt (X : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar n => typ_bvar n
  | typ_fvar Y => if X == Y then U else typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tqt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T1 => typ_qall Q (subst_tqt X U T1)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (subst_tqt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (subst_tqt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (subst_tqt X U T1)
  end
with subst_tqt (X : atom) (U : typ) (T : qtyp) {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T1 => qtyp_qtyp Q (subst_tt X U T1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_qt (X : atom) (R : qua) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar n => typ_bvar n
  | typ_fvar Y => typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_qqt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_qt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_qall Q T1 => typ_qall (subst_qq X R Q) (subst_qqt X R T1)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (subst_qqt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (subst_qqt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (subst_qqt X R T1)
  end
with subst_qqt (X : atom) (R : qua) (T : qtyp) {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T1 => qtyp_qtyp (subst_qq X R Q) (subst_qt X R T1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ee (x : atom) (v e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => if x == y then v else exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee x v e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_ee x v e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2) (subst_ee x v e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (subst_ee x v e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (X : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (subst_tqt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te X U e1) (subst_tt X U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_te X U e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2) (subst_te X U e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (subst_te X U e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_qe (X : atom) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 =>
      exp_abs (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qqt X R V) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)

```
Fixpoint lc_qua (k:nat) (Q:qua) : Prop :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base _ => True
  | qua_bvar n => n < k
  | qua_fvar _ => True
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => lc_qua k Q1 /\ lc_qua k Q2
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => lc_qua k Q1 /\ lc_qua k Q2
  end.

Fixpoint lc_typ (k:nat) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar n => n < k
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow q1 q2 => lc_qtyp k q1 /\ lc_qtyp k q2
  | typ_all T1 q => lc_typ k T1 /\ lc_qtyp (S k) q
  | typ_qall Q q => lc_qua k Q /\ lc_qtyp (S k) q
  | typ_sum ... 
  | typ_pair ...
  | typ_ref q => lc_qtyp k q
  end
with lc_qtyp (k:nat) (T:qtyp) : Prop :=
  match T with qtyp_qtyp Q T => lc_qua k Q /\ lc_typ k T end.

Fixpoint lc_exp (k:nat) (e:exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar n => n < k
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs P V e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_qtyp k V /\ lc_exp (S k) e1
```

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Local closure (all free indices are below a given level)           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint lc_qua (k : nat) (Q : qua) : Prop :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base _ => True
  | qua_bvar n => n < k
  | qua_fvar _ => True
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => lc_qua k Q1 /\ lc_qua k Q2
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => lc_qua k Q1 /\ lc_qua k Q2
  end.

Fixpoint lc_typ (k : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar n => n < k
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_qtyp k T1 /\ lc_qtyp k T2
  | typ_all T1 T2 => lc_typ k T1 /\ lc_qtyp (S k) T2
  | typ_qall Q T1 => lc_qua k Q /\ lc_qtyp (S k) T1
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => lc_qtyp k T1 /\ lc_qtyp k T2
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => lc_qtyp k T1 /\ lc_qtyp k T2
  | typ_ref T1 => lc_qtyp k T1
  end
with lc_qtyp (k : nat) (T : qtyp) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T1 => lc_qua k Q /\ lc_typ k T1
  end.

Fixpoint lc_exp (k : nat) (e : exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar n => n < k
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs P V e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_qtyp k V /\ lc_exp (S k) e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_typ k V /\ lc_exp (S k) e1
  | exp_tapp e1 V => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_typ k V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_qua k Q /\ lc_exp (S k) e1
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_qua k Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp (S k) e2
  | exp_inl P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_inr P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp (S k) e2 /\ lc_exp (S k) e3
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2
  | exp_first e1 => lc_exp k e1
  | exp_second e1 => lc_exp k e1
  | exp_ref P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_ref_label P _ => lc_qua k P
  | exp_deref e1 => lc_exp k e1
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2
  | exp_upqual P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_check P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  end.

Lemma lc_qua_mono : forall k k' Q, k <= k' -> lc_qua k Q -> lc_qua k' Q.
Proof.
  intros k k' Q Hle. induction Q; simpl; auto; intros H; try lia.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
Qed.

Scheme typ_mut_ind := Induction for typ Sort Prop
  with qtyp_mut_ind := Induction for qtyp Sort Prop.

Lemma lc_typ_mono : forall T, (forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_typ k T -> lc_typ k' T).
Proof.
  apply typ_mut_ind with
    (P := fun T => forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_typ k T -> lc_typ k' T)
    (P0 := fun T => forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_qtyp k T -> lc_qtyp k' T).
  - intros; exact I.
  - intros n k k' Hle H; simpl in *; lia.
  - intros; exact I.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; auto. apply IH2 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - intros Q q IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply lc_qua_mono with (k := k); auto| apply IH2 with (k := S k); auto]; lia.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q IH k k' Hle H. simpl in *. apply IH with (k := k); auto.
  - intros Q T IH k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply lc_qua_mono with (k := k); auto| apply IH with (k := k); auto].
Qed.

Lemma lc_qtyp_mono : forall T k k', k <= k' -> lc_qtyp k T -> lc_qtyp k' T.
Proof.
  intros [Q T] k k' Hle H. simpl in *. destruct H as [H1 H2].
  split; [apply lc_qua_mono with (k := k); auto| apply lc_typ_mono with (k := k); auto].
Qed.

Lemma lc_exp_mono : forall e k k', k <= k' -> lc_exp k e -> lc_exp k' e.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; intros k k' Hle H; auto;
  try (destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [..|try apply IHe2]; auto);
  try (destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]; split; [..|split]; auto);
  try lia.
  - (* abs *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* tabs *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* qabs *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* let *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; auto. apply IHe2 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* case *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe2 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
    apply IHe3 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
Qed.

(* identity of opening on locally closed objects *)
Lemma lc_qua_id : forall Q k K R, lc_qua k Q -> k <= K -> open_qq_rec K R Q = Q.
Proof.
  induction Q; simpl; intros k K R Hlk Hle; auto.
  - lia.
  - destruct Hlk as [H1 H2]; f_equal; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
  - destruct Hlk as [H1 H2]; f_equal; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_id_tt : forall T, (forall k K W, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_tt_rec K W T = T).
Proof.
  apply typ_mut_ind with
    (P := fun T => forall k K W, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_tt_rec K W T = T)
    (P0 := fun T => forall k K W, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_tqt_rec K W T = T).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros n k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct (Nat.eq_dec K n) as [e|e]; auto.
    exfalso. lia.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros Q q IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q IH k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros Q T IH k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_qtyp_id_tqt : forall T k K W, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_tqt_rec K W T = T.
Proof.
  intros [Q T] k K W Hlk Hle. simpl in *. apply lc_typ_id_tt with (k := k) (K := K); tauto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_id_qt : forall T, (forall k K R, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_qt_rec K R T = T).
Proof.
  apply typ_mut_ind with
    (P := fun T => forall k K R, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_qt_rec K R T = T)
    (P0 := fun T => forall k K R, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_qqt_rec K R T = T).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros Q q IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite lc_qua_id with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q IH k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros Q T IH k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite lc_qua_id with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_qtyp_id_qqt : forall T k K R, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_qqt_rec K R T = T.
Proof.
  intros [Q T] k K R Hlk Hle. simpl in *. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2]. simpl.
  rewrite lc_qua_id with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  apply lc_typ_id_qt with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Free variables                                                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint fv_qua (Q : qua) : atoms :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base _ => empty
  | qua_bvar _ => empty
  | qua_fvar X => singleton X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qua Q1) (fv_qua Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qua Q1) (fv_qua Q2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => empty
  | typ_bvar _ => empty
  | typ_fvar X => singleton X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => union (fv_qtyp T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => union (fv_typ T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => union (fv_qua Q) (fv_qtyp T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => union (fv_qtyp T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => union (fv_qtyp T1) (fv_qtyp T2)
  | typ_ref T => fv_qtyp T
  end
with fv_qtyp (T : qtyp) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => union (fv_qua Q) (fv_typ T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_exp (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => empty
  | exp_fvar x => singleton x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_qtyp V) (fv_exp e1))
  | exp_app e1 e2 => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_typ V) (fv_exp e1))
  | exp_tapp e1 V => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_typ V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_qua Q) (fv_exp e1))
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_qua Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => union (fv_exp e1) (union (fv_exp e2) (fv_exp e3))
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => union (fv_qua P) (union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2))
  | exp_first e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_second e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_ref P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_ref_label P _ => fv_qua P
  | exp_deref e1 => fv_exp e1
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => union (fv_exp e1) (fv_exp e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => union (fv_qua P) (fv_exp e1)
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitutions                                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint subst_qq (X : atom) (R Q : qua) {struct Q} : qua :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base b => qua_base b
  | qua_bvar n => qua_bvar n
  | qua_fvar Y => if X == Y then R else qua_fvar Y
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (subst_qq X R Q1) (subst_qq X R Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => qua_join (subst_qq X R Q1) (subst_qq X R Q2)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_tt (X : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar n => typ_bvar n
  | typ_fvar Y => if X == Y then U else typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tqt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T1 => typ_qall Q (subst_tqt X U T1)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (subst_tqt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (subst_tqt X U T1) (subst_tqt X U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (subst_tqt X U T1)
  end
with subst_tqt (X : atom) (U : typ) (T : qtyp) {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T1 => qtyp_qtyp Q (subst_tt X U T1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_qt (X : atom) (R : qua) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar n => typ_bvar n
  | typ_fvar Y => typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_qqt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_qt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_qall Q T1 => typ_qall (subst_qq X R Q) (subst_qqt X R T1)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (subst_qqt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (subst_qqt X R T1) (subst_qqt X R T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (subst_qqt X R T1)
  end
with subst_qqt (X : atom) (R : qua) (T : qtyp) {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T1 => qtyp_qtyp (subst_qq X R Q) (subst_qt X R T1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ee (x : atom) (v e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => if x == y then v else exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee x v e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_ee x v e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2) (subst_ee x v e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_ee x v e1) (subst_ee x v e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (subst_ee x v e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (subst_ee x v e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (X : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (subst_tqt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (subst_tt X U V) (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te X U e1) (subst_tt X U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_te X U e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2) (subst_te X U e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (subst_te X U e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (subst_te X U e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_qe (X : atom) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 =>
      exp_abs (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qqt X R V) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 =>
      exp_tabs (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qt X R V) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qt X R V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 =>
      exp_qabs (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qq X R Q) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qq X R Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2) (subst_qe X R e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 =>
      exp_pair (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label (subst_qq X R P) l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Local closure (all free indices are below a given level)           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint lc_qua (k : nat) (Q : qua) : Prop :=
  match Q with
  | qua_base _ => True
  | qua_bvar n => n < k
  | qua_fvar _ => True
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => lc_qua k Q1 /\ lc_qua k Q2
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => lc_qua k Q1 /\ lc_qua k Q2
  end.

Fixpoint lc_typ (k : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar n => n < k
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_qtyp k T1 /\ lc_qtyp k T2
  | typ_all T1 T2 => lc_typ k T1 /\ lc_qtyp (S k) T2
  | typ_qall Q T1 => lc_qua k Q /\ lc_qtyp (S k) T1
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => lc_qtyp k T1 /\ lc_qtyp k T2
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => lc_qtyp k T1 /\ lc_qtyp k T2
  | typ_ref T1 => lc_qtyp k T1
  end
with lc_qtyp (k : nat) (T : qtyp) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T1 => lc_qua k Q /\ lc_typ k T1
  end.

Fixpoint lc_exp (k : nat) (e : exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar n => n < k
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs P V e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_qtyp k V /\ lc_exp (S k) e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_typ k V /\ lc_exp (S k) e1
  | exp_tapp e1 V => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_typ k V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_qua k Q /\ lc_exp (S k) e1
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_qua k Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp (S k) e2
  | exp_inl P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_inr P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp (S k) e2 /\ lc_exp (S k) e3
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2
  | exp_first e1 => lc_exp k e1
  | exp_second e1 => lc_exp k e1
  | exp_ref P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_ref_label P _ => lc_qua k P
  | exp_deref e1 => lc_exp k e1
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2
  | exp_upqual P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_check P e1 => lc_qua k P /\ lc_exp k e1

Lemma lc_qua_mono : forall k k' Q, k <= k' -> lc_qua k Q -> lc_qua k' Q.
Proof.
  intros k k' Q Hle. induction Q; simpl; auto; intros H; try lia.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
Qed.

Scheme typ_mut_ind := Induction for typ Sort Prop
  with qtyp_mut_ind := Induction for qtyp Sort Prop.

Lemma lc_typ_mono : forall T, (forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_typ k T -> lc_typ k' T).
Proof.
  apply typ_mut_ind with
    (P := fun T => forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_typ k T -> lc_typ k' T)
    (P0 := fun T => forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_qtyp k T -> lc_qtyp k' T).
  - intros; exact I.
  - intros n k k' Hle H; simpl in *; lia.
  - intros; exact I.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; auto. apply IH2 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - intros Q q IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply lc_qua_mono with (k := k); auto| apply IH2 with (k := S k); auto]; lia.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q IH k k' Hle H. simpl in *. apply IH with (k := k); auto.
  - intros Q T IH k k' Hle H. simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
    split; [apply lc_qua_mono with (k := k); auto| apply IH with (k := k); auto].
Qed.

Lemma lc_qtyp_mono : forall T k k', k <= k' -> lc_qtyp k T -> lc_qtyp k' T.
Proof.
  intros [Q T] k k' Hle H. simpl in *. destruct H as [H1 H2].
  split; [apply lc_qua_mono with (k := k); auto| apply lc_typ_mono with (k := k); auto].
Qed.

Lemma lc_exp_mono : forall e k k', k <= k' -> lc_exp k e -> lc_exp k' e.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; intros k k' Hle H; auto;
  try (destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [..|try apply IHe2]; auto);
  try (destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]; split; [..|split]; auto);
  try lia.
  - (* abs *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* tabs *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* qabs *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* let *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; auto. apply IHe2 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
  - (* case *) destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; auto.
    apply IHe2 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
    apply IHe3 with (k := S k); auto. lia.
Qed.

(* identity of opening on locally closed objects *)
Lemma lc_qua_id : forall Q k K R, lc_qua k Q -> k <= K -> open_qq_rec K R Q = Q.
Proof.
  induction Q; simpl; intros k K R Hlk Hle; auto.
  - lia.
  - destruct Hlk as [H1 H2]; f_equal; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
  - destruct Hlk as [H1 H2]; f_equal; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_id_tt : forall T, (forall k K W, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_tt_rec K W T = T).
Proof.
  apply typ_mut_ind with
    (P := fun T => forall k K W, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_tt_rec K W T = T)
    (P0 := fun T => forall k K W, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_tqt_rec K W T = T).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros n k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct (Nat.eq_dec K n) as [e|e]; auto.
    exfalso. lia.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros Q q IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q IH k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros Q T IH k K W Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_qtyp_id_tqt : forall T k K W, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_tqt_rec K W T = T.
Proof.
  intros [Q T] k K W Hlk Hle. simpl in *. apply lc_typ_id_tt with (k := k) (K := K); tauto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_id_qt : forall T, (forall k K R, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_qt_rec K R T = T).
Proof.
  apply typ_mut_ind with
    (P := fun T => forall k K R, lc_typ k T -> k <= K -> open_qt_rec K R T = T)
    (P0 := fun T => forall k K R, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_qqt_rec K R T = T).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros Q q IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite lc_qua_id with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := S k) (K := S K); auto. lia.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite IH1 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH2 with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros q IH k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  - intros Q T IH k K R Hlk Hle. simpl. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2].
    rewrite lc_qua_id with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
    rewrite IH with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_qtyp_id_qqt : forall T k K R, lc_qtyp k T -> k <= K -> open_qqt_rec K R T = T.
Proof.
  intros [Q T] k K R Hlk Hle. simpl in *. destruct Hlk as [H1 H2]. simpl.
  rewrite lc_qua_id with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
  apply lc_typ_id_qt with (k := k) (K := K); auto.
Qed.

```
Lemma subst_qq_fresh : forall X R Q, X `notin` fv_qua Q -> subst_qq X R Q = Q.
```

Lemma subst_tt_fresh : forall T, (forall X U, X `notin` fv_typ T -> subst_tt X U T = T).
Proof.

Lemma subst_qq_fvar_eq : forall X R, subst_qq X R (qua_fvar X) = R.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (X == X) as [e|e]; auto. exfalso. apply e. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_qq_fvar_neq : forall X Y R, X <> Y -> subst_qq X R (qua_fvar Y) = qua_fvar Y.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (X == Y) as [e|e]; auto. exfalso. apply H. exact e.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_eq : forall X U, subst_tt X U (typ_fvar X) = U.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (X == X) as [e|e]; auto. exfalso. apply e. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_neq : forall X Y U, X <> Y -> subst_tt X U (typ_fvar Y) = typ_fvar Y.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Commutation of type substitution with type opening                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma subst_tt_open_tt_rec :
  forall T, (forall K X U W, type U ->
    subst_tt X U (open_tt_rec K W T) = open_tt_rec K (subst_tt X U W) (subst_tt X U T)).
Proof.
  apply (typ_mut_ind
    (fun T => forall K X U W, type U ->
       subst_tt X U (open_tt_rec K W T) = open_tt_rec K (subst_tt X U W) (subst_tt X U T))
    (fun T => forall K X U W, type U ->
       subst_tqt X U (open_tqt_rec K W T) = open_tqt_rec K (subst_tt X U W) (subst_tqt X U T))).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros n K X U W HU. simpl. destruct (K == n) as [e|e]; reflexivity.
  - intros Y K X U W HU. simpl. destruct (X == Y) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + symmetry. apply type_open_tt_id. exact HU.
    + reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K) (W := W); exact HU.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K) (W := W); exact HU.
  - intros Q q IH2 K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
    apply IH2 with (K := S K) (W := W); exact HU.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
    + apply IH2 with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
    + apply IH2 with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
  - intros q IH K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
    apply IH with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
  - intros Q T IH K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
    apply IH with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tqt_open_tqt_rec : forall T K X U W, type U ->
  subst_tqt X U (open_tqt_rec K W T) = open_tqt_rec K (subst_tt X U W) (subst_tqt X U T).
Proof.
  intros [Q T] K X U W HU. simpl. f_equal.
  apply subst_tt_open_tt_rec with (K := K) (W := W); exact HU.
Qed.

Lemma subst_qq_open_qq_rec : forall Q K X R R0, qual R ->
  subst_qq X R (open_qq_rec K R0 Q) = open_qq_rec K (subst_qq X R R0) (subst_qq X R Q).
Proof.
  induction Q; simpl; intros K X R R0 HR.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + apply subst_qq_fvar_eq.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (X == a) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + symmetry. apply qual_open_qq_id. exact HR.
    + reflexivity.
  - f_equal; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; exact HR.
  - f_equal; [apply IHQ1|apply IHQ2]; exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma subst_qt_open_qt_rec :
  forall T, (forall K X R R0, qual R ->
    subst_qt X R (open_qt_rec K R0 T) = open_qt_rec K (subst_qq X R R0) (subst_qt X R T)).
Proof.
  apply (typ_mut_ind
    (fun T => forall K X R R0, qual R ->
       subst_qt X R (open_qt_rec K R0 T) = open_qt_rec K (subst_qq X R R0) (subst_qt X R T))
    (fun T => forall K X R R0, qual R ->
       subst_qqt X R (open_qqt_rec K R0 T) = open_qqt_rec K (subst_qq X R R0) (subst_qqt X R T))).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K); exact HR.
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K); exact HR.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K); exact HR.
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K); exact HR.
  - intros Q q IH2 K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply subst_qq_open_qq_rec with (K := K); exact HR.
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K); exact HR.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K); exact HR.
    + apply IH2 with (K := K); exact HR.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K); exact HR.
    + apply IH2 with (K := K); exact HR.
  - intros q IH K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
    apply IH with (K := K); exact HR.
  - intros Q T IH K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply subst_qq_open_qq_rec with (K := K); exact HR.
    + apply IH with (K := K); exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma subst_qqt_open_qqt_rec : forall T K X R R0, qual R ->
  subst_qqt X R (open_qqt_rec K R0 T) = open_qqt_rec K (subst_qq X R R0) (subst_qqt X R T).
Proof.
  intros [Q T] K X R R0 HR. simpl. f_equal.
  + apply subst_qq_open_qq_rec with (K := K); exact HR.
  + apply subst_qt_open_qt_rec with (K := K); exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma subst_qt_open_tt_rec :
  forall T, (forall K X R W, qual R -> X `notin` fv_typ W ->
    subst_qt X R (open_tt_rec K W T) = open_tt_rec K W (subst_qt X R T)).
Proof.

    (fun T => forall K X R W, qual R -> X `notin` fv_typ W ->
       subst_qt X R (open_tt_rec K W T) = open_tt_rec K W (subst_qt X R T))
    (fun T => forall K X R W, qual R -> X `notin` fv_qtyp W ->

  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros n K X R W HR HW. simpl. destruct (K == n) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + symmetry. apply subst_qt_fresh. exact HW.
    + reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
  - intros Q q IH2 K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
    apply IH2 with (K := S K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
    + apply IH2 with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
    + apply IH2 with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
  - intros q IH K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
    apply IH with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
  - intros Q T IH K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
    apply IH with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma subst_qqt_open_tqt_rec : forall T K X R W, qual R -> X `notin` fv_qtyp W ->
  subst_qqt X R (open_tqt_rec K W T) = open_tqt_rec K W (subst_qqt X R T).
Proof.
  intros [Q T] K X R W HR HW. simpl. f_equal.
  apply subst_qt_open_tt_rec with (K := K) (W := W); [exact HR|simpl in HW; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_open_qt_rec :
  forall T, (forall K X U R, type U ->
    subst_tt X U (open_qt_rec K R T) = open_qt_rec K R (subst_tt X U T)).

    (fun T => forall K X U R, type U ->

    (fun T => forall K X U R, type U ->
       subst_tqt X U (open_qqt_rec K R T) = open_qqt_rec K R (subst_tqt X U T))).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros Y K X U R HU. simpl. destruct (X == Y) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + symmetry. apply type_open_qt_id. exact HU.
    + reflexivity.
  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X U R HU. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K); exact HU.
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K); exact HU.
  - intros T1 IH1 q IH2 K X U R HU. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply IH1 with (K := K); exact HU.
    + apply IH2 with (K := S K); exact HU.
  - intros Q q IH2 K X U R HU. simpl. f_equal.

  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X U R HU. simpl. f_equal.

  - intros q1 IH1 q2 IH2 K X U R HU. simpl. f_equal.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Environment relation: preservation of bound type/qualifier vars    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition env_rel (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  (forall x U, binds x (bind_sub U) E -> exists U', binds x (bind_sub U') E') /\
  (forall x Q, binds x (bind_qua Q) E -> exists Q', binds x (bind_qua Q') E').

Lemma env_rel_refl : forall E, env_rel E E.
Proof.
  intros E. split; intros; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_not_middle : forall (A : Type) (z : atom) (p : A) (x : atom) (b b0 : A) (F G : list (atom * A)),
  binds z p (F ++ (x, b) :: G) -> p <> b -> binds z p (F ++ G).
Proof.
  intros A z p x b b0 F G H Hne.
  apply binds_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
  - apply binds_app_2. exact H.
  - apply binds_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [[Heq Hp]|H].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. inversion Heq. exact Hp.
    + apply binds_app_3. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_rel_ctx : forall E E' E1 E2,
  env_rel E E' -> env_rel (E1 ++ E ++ E2) (E1 ++ E' ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E E' E1 E2 [Hsub Hqua]. split.
  - intros x U Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists U. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * destruct (Hsub x U Hb) as [U' HU']. exists U'.
        apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1) in HU'. apply binds_app_2 in HU'. exact HU'.
      * exists U. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
        apply binds_app_3 with (E := E'). exact Hb.
  - intros x Q Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists Q. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * destruct (Hqua x Q Hb) as [Q' HQ']. exists Q'.
        apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1) in HQ'. apply binds_app_2 in HQ'. exact HQ'.
      * exists Q. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
        apply binds_app_3 with (E := E'). exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma env_rel_weaken : forall E E1 E2, env_rel E (E1 ++ E ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros. apply env_rel_ctx with (E1 := E1) (E2 := E2). apply env_rel_refl.
Qed.

Lemma env_rel_cons : forall E E' x b,
  env_rel E E' -> env_rel (x ~ b ++ E) (x ~ b ++ E').
Proof.
  intros. apply env_rel_ctx with (E1 := (x ~ b)) (E2 := nil). simpa using H.
Qed.

Lemma env_rel_remove_typ : forall E1 E2 x U,
  env_rel (E1 ++ (x, bind_typ U) :: E2) (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  split.
  - intros y V Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists V. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Heq Hp]|Hb].
        -- exfalso. inversion Heq. subst. inversion Hp.
        -- exists V. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1). exact Hb.
      * exists V. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1). exact Hb.
  - intros y Q Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists Q. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Heq Hp]|Hb].
        -- exfalso. inversion Heq. subst. inversion Hp.
        -- exists Q. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1). exact Hb.
      * exists Q. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1). exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma env_rel_bind_sub_change : forall E1 E2 x U1 U2,
  env_rel (E1 ++ (x, bind_sub U1) :: E2) (E1 ++ (x, bind_sub U2) :: E2).
Proof.
  split.
  - intros y V Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists V. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Heq Hp]|Hb].
        -- exists U2. inversion Heq. inversion Hp. subst.
           apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1). apply binds_cons_2; auto.
        -- exists V. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
           apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
      * exists V. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
        apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
  - intros y Q Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists Q. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * assert (Hne : (y, bind_qua Q) <> (x, bind_sub U1)).
        { intro Hc. inversion Hc. inversion H3. }
        apply binds_not_middle in Hb; auto.
        exists Q. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
        apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
      * exists Q. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
        apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma env_rel_bind_qua_change : forall E1 E2 x Q1 Q2,
  env_rel (E1 ++ (x, bind_qua Q1) :: E2) (E1 ++ (x, bind_qua Q2) :: E2).
Proof.
  split.
  - intros y V Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists V. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * assert (Hne : (y, bind_sub V) <> (x, bind_qua Q1)).
        { intro Hc. inversion Hc. inversion H3. }
        apply binds_not_middle in Hb; auto.
        exists V. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
        apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
      * exists V. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
        apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
  - intros y Q Hb. apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
    + exists Q. apply binds_app_2. exact Hb.
    + apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb|Hb].
      * apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Heq Hp]|Hb].
        -- exists Q2. inversion Heq. inversion Hp. subst.
           apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1). apply binds_cons_2; auto.
        -- exists Q. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
           apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
      * exists Q. apply binds_app_3 with (E := E1).
           apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma subqual_trans : forall E Q R S,
  subqual E Q R -> subqual E R S -> subqual E Q S.
Proof.
  intros E Q R S H1. revert S.
  induction H1 as
    [ E0 Q0 Hwf HQ
    | E0 Q0 Hwf HQ
    | E0 Q' Q0 R0 b Ha IHa Hc Hc2 IHc2
    | E0 Q' Q0 R0 b Ha IHa Hc Hc2 IHc2
    | E0 b1 b2 Hwf Hord
    | E0 X Hwf HQ
    | R0 E0 Q0 X Hb Ha IHa
    | E0 R1 R2 Q0 Ha IHa HR2
    | E0 R1 R2 Q0 HR1 Ha IHa

### New result of this round

I tested whether the transitivity and narrowing proofs could be written as mutual `Fixpoint`s over derivation trees, which would give exactly the needed induction hypotheses for the reverse-direction arrow composition and for the `sub_all`/`sub_qall` body narrowing. The principled shape would be:

```
with     trans_second (A : sub E T U) : forall S, sub E S T -> sub E S U
with     narrow (A : sub E S T) : ... .
```

```
Elimination of an inductive object of sort Prop is not allowed on a predicate
in sort "Type" because proofs can be eliminated only to build proofs.
```

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Weakening of subtyping under environment inclusion                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition env_incl (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall x b, binds x b E -> binds x b E'.

Lemma env_incl_refl : forall E, env_incl E E.
Proof. intros E x b H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma env_incl_cons : forall E E' x b,
  env_incl E E' -> env_incl (x ~ b ++ E) (x ~ b ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' x b H. intros y c Hy.
  apply binds_cons_iff in Hy. destruct Hy as [[Heq Hc]|Hy].
  - subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
  - apply binds_cons_3. apply H. exact Hy.
Qed.

Lemma env_rel_of_incl : forall E E', env_incl E E' -> env_rel E E'.
Proof.
  intros E E' H. split.
  - intros x U Hb. exists U. apply H. exact Hb.
  - intros x Q Hb. exists Q. apply H. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma wf_qua_incl : forall E E' Q,
  env_incl E E' -> wf_qua E Q -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof. intros. apply wf_qua_env_rel with (E := E); auto. apply env_rel_of_incl; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_incl : forall E E' T,
  env_incl E E' -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof. intros. apply wf_typ_env_rel with (E := E); auto. apply env_rel_of_incl; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_qtyp_incl : forall E E' T,
  env_incl E E' -> wf_qtyp E T -> wf_qtyp E' T.
Proof. intros. apply wf_qtyp_env_rel with (E := E); auto. apply env_rel_of_incl; auto. Qed.

Lemma sub_weaken : forall E S T, sub E S T ->
  forall E', env_incl E E' -> wf_env E' -> sub E' S T.
Proof.

  refine (sub_mut_ind

     ```
Require Export Fsub.ExtendedBase.Label.

Require Export Fsub.FqMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Require Export Fsub.ExtendedBase.Lattice.

Context `{O : Order B}.

Context `{L : Lattice B}.

Context `{@LOSet B O L}.

  | qua_bvar : nat -> qua

  | qua_meet : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_join : qua -> qua -> qua
.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_qall : qua -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_sum : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_pair : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_ref : qtyp -> typ
with qtyp : Set :=
  | qtyp_qtyp : qua -> typ -> qtyp
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp

  | exp_abs : qua -> qtyp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : qua -> typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_qabs : qua -> qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_qapp : exp -> qua -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inl : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inr : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_case : exp -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_pair : qua -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_first : exp -> exp
  | exp_second : exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref_label : qua -> label -> exp
  | exp_deref : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_ref : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_upqual : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_check : qua -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Coercion qua_bvar : nat >-> qua.

Coercion qua_fvar : atom >-> qua.

  match q with
  | qua_base b => Some b
  | qua_fvar X => None
  | qua_bvar n => None
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1, concretize Q2) with

Fixpoint open_qq_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (Q : qua)  {struct Q} : qua :=

  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_tqt_rec K U T1)
  end

  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (open_tt_rec K U T)

Fixpoint open_qt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=

  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>

  | exp_pair R e1 e2 => exp_pair R (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)

Fixpoint open_qe_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qqt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qt_rec K R V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qq_rec K R Q)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qq_rec K R Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label (open_qq_rec K R P) l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)

  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_ee_rec k f e2)

      exp_case (open_ee_rec k f e1)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
```
